name: City of Santa Ana Student Intern
org: City of Santa Ana Human Resources
what_you_do: Work in a city department. Go to quarterly workshops to build job skills. Build mentor ties with department leaders. The city lists a Student Intern level for people enrolled in high school.
who_can_apply: People currently enrolled in high school who can get a work permit. The page does not give a minimum age or a city residency rule.
pay_detail: Pay is not stated on the page
duration: Not stated. Interns keep their spot by sending proof of school enrollment and their GPA after each semester.
deadline_text: The city recruits interns about once a year or as needed. No dates are listed on the page.
how_to_apply: Check the city job site for internship openings and apply there. If none are open, check back later.
